notes: Immediate failure observation from the existing bounded hop index. None means pending or successfully finished, including HTTP errors and redirect hops. Failure preserves errorText and canceled: Option<boolean>; BiDi cancellation is unknown. Requires the original request instance and its live page/context; copied, evicted, foreign or owner-lost requests fail with RequestUnavailable. Save returned failure data before owner closure. No additional retention or instrumentation.

audit.scope: Public immediate-read failure contract, original-instance ownership, bounded retention and protocol cancellation evidence inspected.

decision.quote: Request failure reads inspect the existing bounded hop index immediately, using the original request instance
